map.锯材（板方材）材积计算 使用指南: Sawn Timber (Planks and Battens) Volume User Guide
map.单块材积=厚×宽×长（m）；总材积=Σ单块×数量；按 GB4815-84 板方材: Volume of one piece = thickness × width × length (m); total volume = sum of pieces × quantity; convert to board feet with the GB4815-84 formula or thickness factors; estimated weight = volume × air-dry density. Moisture content affects actual weight.
map.板英尺和立方米怎么换？: How do I convert board feet to cubic metres?
map.1 板英尺≈0.00236 m³（1 m³≈424 板英尺）；外贸常用板英尺，国: 1 board foot is about 0.00236 m³ (1 m³ is about 424 board feet). Foreign trade usually quotes board feet while domestic use uses cubic metres, so unify the unit before settlement to avoid errors.
map.出材率怎么算？: How is the yield rate calculated?
map.出材率=锯材材积÷原木材积×100%，受原木形质、锯解方案与损耗影响，是加工效益: Yield rate = sawn timber volume ÷ log volume × 100%. It depends on log quality, cutting plan and losses, and is a key indicator of processing efficiency.
